name: The Choir Field
description: Act 1, E8 The Choir. A dead, levelled plain of ash and rust, too flat to be natural, ringed by worn mesas. The Choir tends its pylon in the north, walking a ritual loop worn into the ground (`choir-loop`). In the south-west a relic grid still guards a dead mast (`litany`, `dead-mast`); in the south-east a wall of carved code (`code-wall`) holds a fragment of directive syntax the AI flags as its own. Rich isotope seams: the Choir's colony was mining them. Suggested hooks: E8 on first contact, the code fragment at `code-wall` (a Closing Clause hint), and the Choir's regard falling if the mast is torn down.
